## Automating the video production lifecycle with Activepieces


Activepieces connects creative tools to business software across 747+ integrations so that you don't spend your billable hours manually moving files between folders.


By offloading the connective tissue of a production pipeline to a self-hosted or cloud-managed runner, you ensure that metadata and assets remain synchronized without human intervention.


### Syncing assets from cloud storage to editor


To monitor a OneDrive or Google Drive folder for new media, Activepieces uses triggers to route assets based on file extension.


Roughly 60% of these integrations are community-contributed, ensuring that even niche storage providers can be connected to the workspace immediately, which means users aren't reliant on official support to bridge their tools.


When a file is detected, the automation can route the asset based on file extension.


High-resolution B-roll is sent to one directory while audio stems go to another. This logic prevents the "search and rescue" phase of editing where you must hunt through email threads for a missing asset.


### Distributing finished exports to social channels


Activepieces handles the multi-platform upload process once a project is exported, using an MIT-licensed core to ensure the underlying logic remains transparent and extensible. The following workflow demonstrates how a failure in the delivery chain is caught and reported to you instantly.


The screenshot shows a two-step flow titled "Payments Notificati..." where a Stripe "Payment Failed" trigger is connected to a Slack "Send Message To A Channel" action. The right panel displays the Slack action configuration with fields for Action (Send Message To A Channel), Authentication (slack), Channel (activepieces), and Message showing a template with payment failure details.


The left sidebar shows Run Details with step_1 marked as completed with a 574ms duration, and a success notification at the bottom indicates "Run succeeded".


A failed upload or a billing error is addressed in minutes rather than hours because of this visibility into the automation's health.


Following a successful run, the same logic can be applied to YouTube or TikTok to publish the video with pre-written descriptions pulled from a Notion database.


### Archiving projects to external drives automatically


By moving completed exports to long-term storage, Activepieces manages the final stage of the lifecycle. This keeps your primary workspace lean and performant.


Regulated organizations often require total oversight of these assets, which is why the air-gapped edition of Activepieces includes SSO, SCIM, and custom RBAC to match the managed cloud features exactly.


You can verify this by comparing the enterprise feature list (including audit logs and secret managers) between the self-hosted documentation and the SOC 2-compliant cloud regions.


Without you needing to manually prune your local disk, this creates a reliable audit trail of finished work that is searchable by date and client.
